department: Department of Physics / Astrophysics Research Institute

deadline.value: Applications are accepted year-round on a rolling basis, with early submission advised when seeking funding or visa sponsorship.
deadline.quote: You should apply as early as possible if you're also applying for funding, or if you need to secure a UK visa. V

entry_route.value: Applicants submit transcripts and degree certificates to date; standard doctoral entry requires an honours bachelor's or master's qualification.
entry_route.quote: University transcripts and degree certificates to date

supervisor.value: Applicants are instructed to contact potential supervisors in advance to discuss availability and research fit.
supervisor.quote: It’s useful to contact potential supervisors before you make your application. This gives you the chance to discuss their availability and your proposed research.

funding.value: Funded PhD studentships combine structured training and expert collaboration through university awards and research councils.
funding.quote: Be part of the next generation of researchers, combining expert collaboration and structured training on a funded PhD.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test is not stated or required for Astrophysics PhD at Liverpool.

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Astrophysics PhD) in the Department of Physics / Astrophysics Research Institute at the University of Liverpool.
